description: PP-OCRv5 Server profiles for native CPU and NVIDIA CUDA conversion.

models.title: PP-OCRv5 Server text detection
models.source_note: The original retained ONNX export is compiled unchanged with x specialized to [1,3,960,960]. Input images are centered on a black square canvas before BGR resize and normalization. This fixed profile does not claim equivalence to every vendor dynamic-resolution pipeline.

models.title: PP-OCRv5 Server text recognition
models.source_note: The original retained ONNX export is compiled unchanged with x specialized to [1,3,48,320]. BGR text crops use bilinear resize, normalization to [-1,1], then zero padding. Greedy CTC uses blank index 0 and the pinned dictionary. Very wide text strips are constrained by the fixed 320-pixel profile.
